name: Teachable
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of a teachable spirit as essential for gaining wisdom and understanding. Proverbs emphasizes that those who listen to counsel and accept instruction will grow in knowledge and be wise in their later days, while rejecting correction leads to folly and self-destruction. James complements this by describing godly wisdom as gentle, pure, and open to correction, demonstrating that a teachable heart reflects the character of true wisdom from above.
